title: Benchmarking Excellence Specialist
jobDescription:
Where you fit Shell began operations in India more than 80 years ago. At Shell India, we invest in our people through our industry-leading development programmes, which sees our employees thrive and gain access to experts on a local and global level. To date, we have invested more than US$ 1 billion already in India’s energy sector alone, in socially and environmentally responsible ways. Shell is the only global major to have a fuel retail license in India. Shell aims to establish a new hub in Bangalore, and scale it up over a five-year period. What’s the role This role will support Lubricants Americas in delivering its growth ambitions. Lubricants Americas falls under the Shell Global Lubricants umbrella -- A business advancing towards an accelerated growth commitment by 2026 with a 10% CAGR. As part of the Lubricants Americas Supply Chain Optimization and Projects organization, this team will drive world class Sales and Operations Planning for North and South America lubricant supply chain network across multiple sales channels (B2B, B2C, Indirect, Retail, GKAs, etc.). The broad product portfolio includes fast-moving consumer goods, products exclusively developed for key customers, and specialty products with niche applications. What you’ll be doing As the Benchmarking Excellence Specialist within the team, you will play a critical role in ensuring the performances of plant production and supply chain processes remain competitive internally and externally. Through qualitative and quantitative data, you will identify and lead value creation opportunities. This will have to be done while ensuring Lubricants drives towards best in class. You’ll thrive by working closely with global excellence teams, regional production sites, and external resources to meet evolving customer and business needs. More specifically, your role will include: Collaborate with global process quality community, global planning excellence community, and lubricant blending and packaging production site leadership to understand gaps in becoming top quartile supply chain. Collect and analyze internal and external qualitative and quantitative information and data to assess the effectiveness of production within North America and the effectiveness of the supply chain processes which include planning systems. Benchmark Lubricants Americas E2E performance and develop actionable insights Lead and develop a consistent pipeline of value creation projects incorporating the results of the benchmarking study. Utilize project management tools and techniques while driving accountability in project delivery. What we need from you The right candidate is a curious learner who is collaborative, analytical, and has a track record of idea generation and execution. You will work with many stakeholders (globally, regionally, and within individual production sites). You will work with qualitative and quantitative data both internally and externally to provide benchmarking analysis on production performance and process system effectiveness. You will be responsible for developing and executing on the key value creation opportunities as identified in the benchmarking exercise. When it comes to implementation, it’s your excellent people skills that will make the difference. You will inspire people to make changes that will have a direct impact on our commercial success. Additional qualities and experiences that would be beneficial: Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, or a related field With at least 6 – 10 years of experience in supply chain optimization, strategy consulting Knowledge of manufacturing and operations (e.g. consumer goods, bottling, automobile) as well as demand and supply planning systems and processes would be valuable to the position Comfortable with data analysis (internal and external data) Excellent communication skills, ability to build a shared vision and an ability to influence other people at all levels within the organization Strong stakeholder management skills Ability to identify and respond quickly to changing priorities and multi-task The role will be based out of Bangalore, India to support the lubricants business in the North America. The working hours will be partial US hours (Houston) with some flexibility. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams. Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes. We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here. IMPORTANT NOTE: After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from Hire Vue
- please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.
- Shell in India Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalization, and business operations. Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by
2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country. Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities. Shell owns and operates an LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and an LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Spring Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Spring is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure. Our three capability centers across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector. We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programs on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar. DISCLAIMER: Please note: We occasionally amend or withdraw Shell jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Before applying, you are advised to read our data protection policy. This policy describes the processing that may be associated with your personal data and informs you that your personal data may be transferred to Shell/Shell Group companies around the world. The Shell Group and its approved recruitment consultants will never ask you for a fee to process or consider your application for a career with Shell. Anyone who demands such a fee is not an authorised Shell representative and you are strongly advised to refuse any such demand. Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Register here and Set up your job alerts AI is an integral part of today’s recruitment landscape. It can assist in refining ideas, improving clarity, and supporting interview preparation—provided your application remains authentic and reflects your true experience. AI must not be used to fabricate, falsify, or misrepresent any information. Review our full guidelines. You can be a part of the future of energy. Together at Shell, we are transitioning to become a net-zero emissions business while providing the energy that people around the world need today. Working with experienced colleagues , you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills, in an environment where we value honesty, integrity and respect for one another. At Shell, you progress as we tackle the energy challenge together. #Power Your Progress Visit our careers site Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies, a place where everyone – from our employees to our customers, partners and suppliers – feels valued, respected, and has a strong sense of belonging. Find out more about DE&I at Shell Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 96,000 people across more than 70 countries. Whether they work on our platforms and pipelines, or in our offices and research labs, people are key to our success. They collectively determine our culture and we expect them to behave according to our values: honesty, integrity, and respect for people. Learn more about our purpose and strategy “If you need any assistance or support while applying for a job, please contact us at careers@shell.com”

title: Associate QA Analyst - Endur

title: Subsidiary Governance Specialist
jobDescription:
What's the role The individual will hold a Company Secretarial qualification or have a background as a corporate lawyer with at least five years company secretarial experience within a fast paced global or a highly matrixed multinational company. Knowledge of best practice for all relevant legal and regulatory requirements will be necessary for the effective delivery of the role. The individual must have the maturity and gravitas to deal with senior stakeholders and experience of leading and managing teams. Ideally, s/he will have a strong, inquisitive mind with the ability to exercise judgement, strong focus on detail, execution and reliability. Confidentiality and discretion are critical due to the exposure to confidential information. This person will exhibit a natural confidence and strong presence, modelling the core values and expected behavior of the organisation and inspiring his/her colleagues to do the same. This position sits within the Global Subsidiary Governance Operations team, supporting company secretarial delivery for entities across multiple jurisdictions. Therefore, prior experience managing company secretarial requirements and completing corporate filings in many jurisdictions is critical. The individual will also need to demonstrate knowledge and/or experience of automation tools and leveraging data insights and technology in ways of working and process improvement. This is a truly global team, therefore, other language skills, in addition to English, are preferred. What you'll be doing Support the Directors of Shell entities. Support senior internal stakeholders with company secretarial matters and advising on internal governance procedures. Respond to authorised signatory’s queries in the run up to board meetings, providing advice and guidance including governance best practice initiatives. Build strong working relationships cross-functionally and advising the business on governance best practice, using initiatives and technology to address and improve ways of working and increase efficiency. Provide advice and guidance on governance best practice and legal entity administration for the companies allocated and for which s/he will hold primary responsibility. Provide cover for other companies for which one of the other company secretarial advisers has primary responsibility in case of leave, or other absence. Organise and conduct Board Meetings including drafting suitable proposals, collecting and distributing papers and agendas, producing minutes and communicating decisions to all those concerned with implementation/observance. Advise on Board papers and documentation requiring approval at Board Meetings and shareholder meetings (such as capital changes and company name changes) and other issues concerning company law and company secretarial practice. Maintain Action Items List from Board meetings and track completion of the actions. Act as corporate governance compliance officer charged with ensuring compliance by Shell entities globally with all statutory provisions. Advise on and prepare documents for company incorporations and process all formalities for incorporating new companies. Confident in the use of GEMS to ensure the production and filing in due time with local registries. Transactional and project support including providing support on company secretarial and company law aspects of planning projects, overseeing projects or initiatives regarding subsidiaries such as the legal entity management system. Ensuring proper records management for all decisions and associated documentation. General Matters Manage junior team members and oversee their deliverables. Re-calibrating and reallocating workload as priorities change. Keep under review the broader Shell subsidiary governance processes, controls and ways of working within the Secretariat team; and keep under review Shell’s subsidiary management policies and frameworks and ensure that the subsidiaries for which s/he has responsibility are aligned with the other Group companies. Counsel Directors and other corporate secretariat team members on corporate governance regulations and practice and appropriate Group policies and procedures and the interpretation of constitutional documents and implementation of corporate procedures. Advise on Company Law affecting preparation of statutory accounts and reviewing statutory accounts for compliance and accuracy. Review Articles of Association and proposed changes thereto of new/existing subsidiary companies globally for acceptability/practicality. Keep up to date with regulatory changes in the corporate field and best practice movements in company secretarial practice with emphasis on appropriate developments in IT based solutions and the need to build knowledge management techniques. Deliver ad hoc corporate governance projects. Identifying and adopt new ways of working and implement new processes. Level of Authority (The scope of the role) Liaising with Shell subsidiary Directors on various company boards. Acting as Company Secretary within the parameters set by the subsidiary boards of the companies for which s/he is responsible and liaising with the internal stakeholders for those subsidiaries, including business, compliance, finance and legal colleagues. The role requires communication with external parties such as local registries, Company Auditors, Third Party Law Firms, Third Party Banks and various Other Third-Party Bodies whether as part of a commercial transaction or in compliance with legislative requirements. What you bring Qualified Company Secretary (or equivalent) with a minimum of 5 years post qualification experience. Demonstrated track record in subsidiary management roles. Native or advanced level English skills is required. Other language skills, in addition to English, is preferred. Ability to effectively manage relationships with the key stakeholders relevant to the board (s) for which you have been allocated responsibility. Learning agility, conceptual thinker with problem solving and analytical capability. Proactive, forward thinking and innovative, well organised with the ability to work under pressure. Ability to balance inquiry and advocacy, with good stakeholder management and influencing skills. Contextualizing and helping colleagues embrace change. Proven collaboration and project management skills. Adaptable to different cultures and working with diverse and virtual teams. Proven high delivery and project management capability. Experience of documenting processes and developing process manuals. Experience with automation and leveraging technology in ways of working and process improvement. Excellent planning and organisation skills, verbal and written skills, attention to detail and have the ability to work in a fast-paced, varied environment. Material business acumen and ability to focus and deliver in a broad range of scenarios. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of company secretarial practices and procedures. Able to mediate and assist in achieving consensus. Ability to establish and build appropriate, active and informative relationships with relevant stakeholders are in place. Experience with completing corporate filings in many jurisdictions including and not limited to Australia, Singapore, UK, Canada, Malaysia, India, Poland, Italy, Spain, Thailand and other jurisdictions. Proficiency in GEMs, Microsoft Word, Power Automate, Power Point, Power BI, Share Point, Docusign, Diligent Entities, Service Now, and Co Pilot After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. title: Sr. Functional Analyst - Tax
jobDescription:
What’s the role? As a Sr. Functional Consultant
- Tax, you are responsible for planning, controlling, and executing projects, programs, or a set of related initiatives to address defined business needs and deliver value. For programs, you coordinate multiple interconnected projects to achieve benefits that cannot be realized when they are managed individually. What you’ll be doing?
1. Solution Design & Functional Leadership Drive global SAP FI and Indirect Tax solutions from a functional design perspective. Lead S/4HANA Tax solutions for Indirect Tax interfaces, with Global Next & Enterprise Cloud Determination Conduct design lead sessions and coordinate with peer SMEs. Partner with Project Managers for solution design and effort estimation. Contribute to and supervise development of functional specifications from a technical design perspective. Design and oversee development of reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms of varying complexity. Perform prototyping to support requirements definition and design validation.
2. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration Collaborate with Process Experts, SMEs, and Product Managers to streamline Tax L&F requirements. Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into functional solutions. Work closely with Design Leads and Delivery Leads to ensure new capabilities are applied effectively. Coordinate with Change Management and Release Management teams; collaborate via Azure Dev Ops. Manage batch job scheduling, period-end activities, and coordinate cross scrums, Direct and Indirect Tax teams.
3. Quality Assurance & Testing Perform quality assessments and peer reviews. Execute unit and integration testing, support user acceptance testing. Resolve defects during test cycles and provide post-go-live support. Create and review cutover activities and run books for operational readiness.
4. Support & Compliance Assist in resolving production issues with Support teams. Prepare audit and compliance reporting requirements. What we need from you? Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Core Expertise 10+ year's experience in SAP / S4 end to end implementation projects. 5+ year's experience in ECC to S/4HANA transformation projects. 5+ Years experience in Global Next & OITD Private Cloud / Enterprise Cloud projects. Strong Functional knowledge on Indirect Tax and global tax regimes. Technical Skills Expertise in Global Next and One Source Asset Integrity Projects. Expertise with SAP Tax Compliance for automated audits and risk detection using ML. Expertise in SAP DRC, HANA reporting, E-Invoicing & E-Reporting middleware systems. Expertise in working with AI tools Ability to debug issues and identify root causes (preferred techno-functional profile). Familiarity with cross integration modules like OTC, PGS, HM and FI modules. Functional & Leadership Skills Gravitas and excellent communication skills to engage senior finance stakeholders. Strong collaboration with process owners and finance leadership. Active participation in high-performing IT teams focused on business value delivery. Agile & Tools Solid understanding of Agile frameworks, Azure Dev Ops, and Power Platform Apps Experience planning and leading Agile initiatives and educating stakeholders. Integration & Compliance Experience with ERP-to-ERP interfaces and third-party application integration with S4. Skilled in tax audits, regulatory compliance, and discrepancy resolution. Ability to optimize tax liabilities through effective planning and structuring. IMPORTANT NOTICE: After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from Hire Vue
- please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.

title: Technical Specialist - Reliability Core
jobDescription:
What’s the role As Technical Specialist
- Reliability Core, you will provide expert technical leadership in reliability engineering, maintenance strategy development, and asset performance improvement. You will lead complex Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) studies and reliability improvement initiatives across operating assets, turning equipment history, risk information, and operational insight into practical maintenance and improvement strategies. This is a hands-on specialist role with a strong consulting and facilitation element. You will work with multidisciplinary asset teams, challenge technical assumptions constructively, assure the quality of reliability studies, and coach others in the effective application of reliability methods. You will also help teams make better use of analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities where these can deliver clear business value. What you’ll be doing Reliability Strategy & Asset Care Reliability Engineering & Continuous Improvement Apply reliability methods such as RCM, FMEA, RAM analysis, Weibull analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, and lifecycle cost analysis to support sound technical decisions. Identify recurring equipment failures, bad actors, and performance gaps, and lead structured reliability improvement activities to address them. Lead or support Root Cause Failure Analysis and Causal Learning investigations for significant or repeat equipment failures. Develop recommendations that are technically robust, proportionate to risk, and practical for asset teams to implement. Capture lessons learned and use them to improve reliability work processes, tools, and ways of working. Reliability Statistical Analysis Apply advanced reliability statistical techniques to evaluate failure behaviour, predict equipment performance, and support maintenance strategy optimization. Perform Weibull Analysis, Crow-AMSAA Reliability Growth Modelling, and other probabilistic methods to assess failure patterns, reliability trends, and system improvement opportunities. Develop and utilize Monte Carlo Simulations to quantify uncertainty, assess risk scenarios, and support asset investment and lifecycle decisions. Conduct Remaining Useful Life (RUL) assessments and degradation modeling to support predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and intervention planning. Lead Asset Life Extension (ALE) studies by evaluating equipment condition, failure risk, operating context, and life-cycle economics to support safe and reliable operation beyond original design life. Translate statistical findings into actionable recommendations that improve asset availability, reliability performance, maintenance effectiveness, and business value. Reliability analytics, digital and AI solutions Analyse equipment and maintenance data to identify failure trends, reliability risks, bad actors, and optimization opportunities. Develop or support reliability KPIs, dashboards, and analytical insights that enable timely and informed decision-making. Use reliability statistics and modelling to support maintenance, risk, and investment decisions. Identify practical opportunities for predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and AI-enabled reliability solutions. Collaborate with digital, analytics, and data science teams to translate reliability challenges into usable, value-focused solutions. Support adoption of digital reliability tools, intelligent agents, and data-driven workflows, with appropriate attention to data quality and user needs. Technical leadership and assurance Provide expert review and technical assurance for complex reliability studies, maintenance strategies, and reliability improvement recommendations. Challenge assumptions, data quality, and proposed actions constructively to improve the quality of technical decisions. Provide guidance on the appropriate selection and application of reliability methods for different business problems. Act as a trusted subject matter expert for complex reliability and maintenance strategy challenges. Coach engineers and practitioners and contribute to the development of reliability capability across the organization. Stakeholder Engagement Facilitate multidisciplinary workshops involving Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Inspection, and Technical Authorities. Provide technical coaching and mentorship in reliability methodologies and best practices. Influence stakeholders and drive implementation of reliability recommendations. Interface with global asset teams, OEMs, vendors, and subject matter experts to deliver reliability improvements. Business Impact The role supports operating assets across Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, and Energy environments. Your work will contribute to safer and more reliable operations through improved asset availability, stronger maintenance effectiveness, reduced repeat failures, better risk management, and optimized lifecycle cost. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering. Minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, Chemical, Manufacturing, or a related asset-intensive environment. Core Reliability Competencies Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) Preventive Maintenance Optimization (PMO) Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reliability, Availability & Maintainability (RAM) Mange Threat & Opportunity (MTO) Reliability Living Program Reliability Statistical Analysis Weibull Analysis Reliability Growth Analysis Probability Distributions and Failure Modelling Reliability Forecasting Uncertainty and Sensitivity Analysis Reliability Analytics & Digital Skills Reliability data analysis and performance trending. Development of reliability KPIs and dashboards. SAP PM/MM and enterprise asset management systems. Data-driven maintenance optimization methodologies. AI & Emerging Digital Capabilities Understanding of AI and machine learning applications in asset reliability. Experience supporting predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, or AI-enabled reliability initiatives. Ability to work with digital, analytics, and data science teams to deliver business value. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams. Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes. After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from Hire Vue

sourceDescription: What’s the role As Technical Specialist - Reliability Core, you will provide expert technical leadership in reliability engineering, maintenance strategy development, and asset performance improvement. You will lead complex Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) studies and reliability improvement initiatives across operating assets, turning equipment history, risk information, and operational insight into practical maintenance and improvement strategies. This is a hands-on specialist role with a strong consulting and facilitation element. You will work with multidisciplinary asset teams, challenge technical assumptions constructively, assure the quality of reliability studies, and coach others in the effective application of reliability methods. You will also help teams make better use of analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI capabilities where these can deliver clear business value. What you’ll be doing Reliability Strategy & Asset Care Reliability Engineering & Continuous Improvement Apply reliability methods such as RCM, FMEA, RAM analysis, Weibull analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, and lifecycle cost analysis to support sound technical decisions. Identify recurring equipment failures, bad actors, and performance gaps, and lead structured reliability improvement activities to address them. Lead or support Root Cause Failure Analysis and Causal Learning investigations for significant or repeat equipment failures. Develop recommendations that are technically robust, proportionate to risk, and practical for asset teams to implement. Capture lessons learned and use them to improve reliability work processes, tools, and ways of working. Reliability Statistical Analysis Apply advanced reliability statistical techniques to evaluate failure behaviour, predict equipment performance, and support maintenance strategy optimization. Perform Weibull Analysis, Crow-AMSAA Reliability Growth Modelling, and other probabilistic methods to assess failure patterns, reliability trends, and system improvement opportunities. Develop and utilize Monte Carlo Simulations to quantify uncertainty, assess risk scenarios, and support asset investment and lifecycle decisions. Conduct Remaining Useful Life (RUL) assessments and degradation modeling to support predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and intervention planning. Lead Asset Life Extension (ALE) studies by evaluating equipment condition, failure risk, operating context, and life-cycle economics to support safe and reliable operation beyond original design life. Translate statistical findings into actionable recommendations that improve asset availability, reliability performance, maintenance effectiveness, and business value. Reliability analytics, digital and AI solutions Analyse equipment and maintenance data to identify failure trends, reliability risks, bad actors, and optimization opportunities. Develop or support reliability KPIs, dashboards, and analytical insights that enable timely and informed decision-making. Use reliability statistics and modelling to support maintenance, risk, and investment decisions. Identify practical opportunities for predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, and AI-enabled reliability solutions. Collaborate with digital, analytics, and data science teams to translate reliability challenges into usable, value-focused solutions. Support adoption of digital reliability tools, intelligent agents, and data-driven workflows, with appropriate attention to data quality and user needs. Technical leadership and assurance Provide expert review and technical assurance for complex reliability studies, maintenance strategies, and reliability improvement recommendations. Challenge assumptions, data quality, and proposed actions constructively to improve the quality of technical decisions. Provide guidance on the appropriate selection and application of reliability methods for different business problems. Act as a trusted subject matter expert for complex reliability and maintenance strategy challenges. Coach engineers and practitioners and contribute to the development of reliability capability across the organization. Stakeholder Engagement Facilitate multidisciplinary workshops involving Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Inspection, and Technical Authorities. Provide technical coaching and mentorship in reliability methodologies and best practices. Influence stakeholders and drive implementation of reliability recommendations. Interface with global asset teams, OEMs, vendors, and subject matter experts to deliver reliability improvements. Business Impact The role supports operating assets across Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, and Energy environments. Your work will contribute to safer and more reliable operations through improved asset availability, stronger maintenance effectiveness, reduced repeat failures, better risk management, and optimized lifecycle cost. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering. Minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, Chemical, Manufacturing, or a related asset-intensive environment. Core Reliability Competencies Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) Preventive Maintenance Optimization (PMO) Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) Failure Modes & Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reliability, Availability & Maintainability (RAM) Mange Threat & Opportunity (MTO) Reliability Living Program Reliability Statistical Analysis Weibull Analysis Reliability Growth Analysis Probability Distributions and Failure Modelling Reliability Forecasting Uncertainty and Sensitivity Analysis Reliability Analytics & Digital Skills Reliability data analysis and performance trending. Development of reliability KPIs and dashboards. SAP PM/MM and enterprise asset management systems. Data-driven maintenance optimization methodologies. AI & Emerging Digital Capabilities Understanding of AI and machine learning applications in asset reliability. Experience supporting predictive maintenance, asset health monitoring, or AI-enabled reliability initiatives. Ability to work with digital, analytics, and data science teams to deliver business value. title: Sr. Team Lead - Reservoir Engineering
jobDescription:
What’s the role The Sr Team Lead – Reservoir Engineering is a leadership role in the Reservoir Engineering Function of TAS (Technical Asset Support) responsible for building, coaching and sustaining a high performing team that can support various assets for RE activities, especially around Shell Reserves and Resource Reporting applications and workflows, with Resource One (Rs1) being the Group Ledger for reporting hydrocarbon resource volumes and the single integrated system for recording, managing & reporting Shell Petroleum Resources, forecast and HCM data capturing OP (Operating Plan) and ARPR (Annual Review of Petroleum Resources). This role includes the responsibility of coordinating the Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (Wf C) activities to support the Shell assets across the globe. As a coordinator, there will be opportunities to cooperate with and gain insight into a wide range of corporate functions and groups such as Resource Assurance and Reporting (RAR), Hydrocarbon Performance (HCP), Finance, Planning and Economics. It also gives opportunities to engage with Resource Volume Managers (RVM), Country Resource Focal Points (CRFP), as well as Reservoir Engineers across Shell. What you’ll be doing (Duties and Responsibilities) The responsibilities of this role include: Working closely with Assets / Reservoir Engineers to understand the current challenges in using the Rs1 application and providing improvement suggestions. Support the E2E workflow in assessing and reporting volumetrics. Participate and support OP/ARPR cycles with necessary data and insights. Ability to perform quality checks and connect with relevant stakeholders for verification / rectification. You will work alongside the Rs1 Product Owner and Rs1 Scrum team as part of the global natural Rs1 team and in close collaboration with the business, RAR, HCP, Finance, RE/PG Discipline and Economics Function. This team supports the assets and the interfaces between Rs1 & other applications and supports overall product lifecycle management and ensures continued alignment with the overall product vision, creating more user value and, in turn, driving greater commercial value for Shell. Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (Wf C) Coordinator: Roles &

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead Wf C workload planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery execution across the TAS team. Manage asset and interface ownership, ensuring complex asset scopes are assigned appropriately. Govern key Rs1 Wf C processes, including user support, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, guidance packs, continuous improvement, KPI management, Share Point administration, workflow governance. Facilitate Wf C team engagement through regular huddles and operational forums. Represent the Wf C community with the Rs1 Product Team, supporting UAT decisions, asset onboarding, interface governance, and enhancement requests. Drive After-Action-Reviews for OP and ARPR cycles, consolidating feedback and identifying improvement opportunities. Contribute to governance forums and stakeholder reviews to enhance Rs1 performance and delivery outcomes. Serve as the focal point for operational excellence, ensuring compliance with agreed workflows, governance standards, and delivery expectations. TAS Team Leadership Accountabilities: Deliver HSSE and code of conduct performance of the team & team tasks. Deliver performance requirements (quality, timeliness, productivity etc.) for scopes migrated to team. Close value and efficiency Gap to Potential (Gt P) for the migrated activities. Maintain organizational capability to deliver team scope and maintain operational continuity. Interface Management etc.). HR Manage team. TAS Team Leadership

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Hire and onboard staff; develop and assure competency and autonomy for task delivery. Integrate team members into Asset/Project natural teams and cadences. Maintain plans for migrated tasks aligned with Asset/Project plans. Conduct regular progress reviews and ensure delivery as planned Define and implement recovery plans when plans/ targets are missed. Implement structured programs to assure team deliverables. Develop and execute operational continuity plans for team scope. Approve competency assessments and learning/development plans. Identify and track improvement opportunities in migrated tasks. Support terms of reference preparation, conduct operational cadence, communication, and reporting per TAS migration framework. You will work closely with the Sr. Process Specialist-Reservoir Engineering to: Develop plans for TAS RE resourcing, timeline, budget, risk and change management Assess the demand and actively work on talent attraction / recruitment and staff retention What you bring Energetic and seasoned Reservoir Engineer with 8+ years of experience in the oil and gas industry. University degree in Petroleum Engineering or a relevant discipline. Technically strong in Reservoir Engineering with good all-round knowledge of other Petroleum Engineering disciplines. Solid understanding of key business processes including Reserves & Resources Reporting, Business Planning, Hydrocarbon Maturation Strategy, Estimation, and Production Forecasting. Experience in developing business cases and demonstrating the value of new functionality is an advantage. Affinity for IT, digitalisation, and automation. Business Analysis experience in an Agile software development environment is an advantage. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across global virtual teams, influence stakeholders, and build trusted relationships across functions and cultures. Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while ensuring objectives are met. Strong aptitude for Continuous Improvement and a learner mindset. Demonstrated leadership capability, including experience working in multidisciplinary teams, coaching and mentoring colleagues, and thinking beyond disciplinary boundaries. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to rapidly identify and focus on key issues. sourceDescription: What’s the role The Sr Team Lead – Reservoir Engineering is a leadership role in the Reservoir Engineering Function of TAS (Technical Asset Support) responsible for building, coaching and sustaining a high performing team that can support various assets for RE activities, especially around Shell Reserves and Resource Reporting applications and workflows, with Resource One (Rs1) being the Group Ledger for reporting hydrocarbon resource volumes and the single integrated system for recording, managing & reporting Shell Petroleum Resources, forecast and HCM data capturing OP (Operating Plan) and ARPR (Annual Review of Petroleum Resources). This role includes the responsibility of coordinating the Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (WfC) activities to support the Shell assets across the globe. As a coordinator, there will be opportunities to cooperate with and gain insight into a wide range of corporate functions and groups such as Resource Assurance and Reporting (RAR), Hydrocarbon Performance (HCP), Finance, Planning and Economics. It also gives opportunities to engage with Resource Volume Managers (RVM), Country Resource Focal Points (CRFP), as well as Reservoir Engineers across Shell. What you’ll be doing (Duties and Responsibilities) The responsibilities of this role include: Working closely with Assets / Reservoir Engineers to understand the current challenges in using the Rs1 application and providing improvement suggestions. Support the E2E workflow in assessing and reporting volumetrics. Participate and support OP/ARPR cycles with necessary data and insights. Ability to perform quality checks and connect with relevant stakeholders for verification / rectification. You will work alongside the Rs1 Product Owner and Rs1 Scrum team as part of the global natural Rs1 team and in close collaboration with the business, RAR, HCP, Finance, RE/PG Discipline and Economics Function. This team supports the assets and the interfaces between Rs1 & other applications and supports overall product lifecycle management and ensures continued alignment with the overall product vision, creating more user value and, in turn, driving greater commercial value for Shell. Rs1 Workflow Consultancy (WfC) Coordinator: Roles & Responsibilities: Lead WfC workload planning, prioritization, coordination, and delivery execution across the TAS team. Manage asset and interface ownership, ensuring complex asset scopes are assigned appropriately. Govern key Rs1 WfC processes, including user support, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, guidance packs, continuous improvement, KPI management, SharePoint administration, workflow governance. Facilitate WfC team engagement through regular huddles and operational forums. Represent the WfC community with the Rs1 Product Team, supporting UAT decisions, asset onboarding, interface governance, and enhancement requests. Drive After-Action-Reviews for OP and ARPR cycles, consolidating feedback and identifying improvement opportunities. Contribute to governance forums and stakeholder reviews to enhance Rs1 performance and delivery outcomes. Serve as the focal point for operational excellence, ensuring compliance with agreed workflows, governance standards, and delivery expectations. Maintain organizational capability to deliver team scope and maintain operational continuity. Interface Management etc.). HR Manage team. You will work closely with the Sr. Process Specialist-Reservoir Engineering to: Develop plans for TAS RE resourcing, timeline, budget, risk and change management Assess the demand and actively work on talent attraction / recruitment and staff retention What you bring Energetic and seasoned Reservoir Engineer with 8+ years of experience in the oil and gas industry. University degree in Petroleum Engineering or a relevant discipline. Technically strong in Reservoir Engineering with good all-round knowledge of other Petroleum Engineering disciplines. Solid understanding of key business processes including Reserves & Resources Reporting, Business Planning, Hydrocarbon Maturation Strategy, Estimation, and Production Forecasting. Experience in developing business cases and demonstrating the value of new functionality is an advantage. Affinity for IT, digitalisation, and automation. Business Analysis experience in an Agile software development environment is an advantage. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across global virtual teams, influence stakeholders, and build trusted relationships across functions and cultures. Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities while ensuring objectives are met. Strong aptitude for Continuous Improvement and a learner mindset. Demonstrated leadership capability, including experience working in multidisciplinary teams, coaching and mentoring colleagues, and thinking beyond disciplinary boundaries. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to rapidly identify and focus on key issues. title: IT Operations Engineer – Realtime
jobDescription:
What’s the role? Operating at the intersection of Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT), the Realtime Operations team supports the critical platforms and services that connect industrial data with business, engineering, and analytics solutions. We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Engineer to support, operate, and continuously improve our AVEVA PI System platform across the Asia-Pacific region. Working as part of a global operations team, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing services that enable critical operational and business processes. Success in this role requires demonstrated capability in three key areas: Realtime Platform Operations Incident & Stakeholder Management Continuous Improvement & Technical Governance This position combines hands-on operational support with troubleshooting, service improvement, automation, and technology modernization activities. What you’ll be doing? Realtime Platform Operations Support the delivery of secure, reliable, and cost-effective AVEVA PI System services across the Asia-Pacific region. Monitor platform health, performance, and availability, proactively addressing operational issues. Investigate and resolve technical issues affecting production services. Support platform upgrades, maintenance activities, and operational readiness initiatives. Contribute to service recovery during major incidents and disruptions. Maintain operational documentation and support procedures. Incident & Stakeholder Management Manage and resolve incidents, problems, and service requests in line with agreed service levels. Coordinate troubleshooting and resolution activities across technical teams, vendors, and service providers. Provide clear and timely communications during incidents and service disruptions. Support root cause investigations and problem management activities. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, technical specialists, and external partners. Continuous Improvement & Technical Governance Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate operational activities. Drive initiatives that improve service reliability, supportability, and operational efficiency. Support security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and risk management activities. Enhance operational monitoring, tooling, and processes. Balance day-to-day operational support with long-term service improvement objectives. What we need from you? undefined Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience supporting and administering AVEVA PI System within a production environment. Strong knowledge of AVEVA PI System architecture, infrastructure, and platform reliability principles. Experience in troubleshooting, monitoring, maintaining, and providing operational support for PI infrastructure and related services. Proven experience supporting business-critical applications, platforms, or real-time services in a production environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. Experience working within service-oriented support environments with a focus on system availability, reliability, and operational excellence. Demonstrated experience with Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes, preferably within an ITIL framework. Proven ability to coordinate incident resolution and collaborate effectively across multiple technical teams and stakeholders. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging business users, vendors, and technical specialists. Experience driving automation, simplification, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service performance and efficiency. Knowledge of security, compliance, risk remediation, and technical debt reduction practices within enterprise technology environments. Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement, operational excellence, and technical governance of infrastructure landscapes. Proficiency with ITIL methodologies, infrastructure monitoring tools, and operational support best practices. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. sourceDescription: What’s the role? Operating at the intersection of Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT), the Realtime Operations team supports the critical platforms and services that connect industrial data with business, engineering, and analytics solutions. We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Engineer to support, operate, and continuously improve our AVEVA PI System platform across the Asia-Pacific region. Working as part of a global operations team, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing services that enable critical operational and business processes. Success in this role requires demonstrated capability in three key areas: Realtime Platform Operations Incident & Stakeholder Management Continuous Improvement & Technical Governance This position combines hands-on operational support with troubleshooting, service improvement, automation, and technology modernization activities. What you’ll be doing? Realtime Platform Operations Support the delivery of secure, reliable, and cost-effective AVEVA PI System services across the Asia-Pacific region. Monitor platform health, performance, and availability, proactively addressing operational issues. Investigate and resolve technical issues affecting production services. Support platform upgrades, maintenance activities, and operational readiness initiatives. Contribute to service recovery during major incidents and disruptions. Maintain operational documentation and support procedures. Incident & Stakeholder Management Manage and resolve incidents, problems, and service requests in line with agreed service levels. Coordinate troubleshooting and resolution activities across technical teams, vendors, and service providers. Provide clear and timely communications during incidents and service disruptions. Support root cause investigations and problem management activities. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, technical specialists, and external partners. Continuous Improvement & Technical Governance Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate operational activities. Drive initiatives that improve service reliability, supportability, and operational efficiency. Support security, compliance, vulnerability remediation, and risk management activities. Enhance operational monitoring, tooling, and processes. Balance day-to-day operational support with long-term service improvement objectives. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging business users, vendors, and technical specialists. title: IT Operations Engineer - SAP BTP
jobDescription:
Shell began operations in India more than 80 years ago. At Shell India, we invest in our people through our industry-leading development programmes, which sees our employees thrive and gain access to experts on a local and global level. To date, we have invested more than US$ 1 billion already in India’s energy sector alone, in socially and environmentally responsible ways. Shell is the only global major to have a fuel retail license in India. The Powering Progress strategy launched early 2021 confirmed the strategic position of the IT Bangalore hub in the energy transition journey. Shell continues the investment in the hub to support the S/4 journey for its key ERP SAP systems. What’s the role The IT Operations Engineer will become a key player in operating Shell’s central SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). You will work together with Service Management teams to deliver stable, reliable and secure application and infrastructure services to business end users. The tasks will be done in close cooperation with Application Support colleagues, Project Delivery team (Co E) and infra suppliers and vendors primarily SAP. As an BTP Operation Engineer, you are responsible to help resolve issues ensuring business continuity for Shell’s BTP Landscape. The role offers the opportunity to upskill in SAP’s latest BTP technology to investigate operational BTP platform issues, determine root cause and to define and implement fixes to restore the service. The team works as a Dev Sec Ops team and is connected to the SAP ART. You will be working in one of our value streams. What you’ll be doing You will support the BTP Operations Landscape Manager to analyze and resolve operational incidents: Provide second line operational IT support for BTP including ticket resolution on BTP Work on incidents raised against the BTP platform Work on problem tickets to find a root cause of a problem or incident. Help in automating tasks using java or python scripting Executing requests to deliver new demands from customers Maintain Azure VM’s that run BTP connectivity services Be involved in delivering new capabilities on the BTP platform Analyze complex business processes, conduct workshops to gather, evaluate, document business needs, critical requirements and translate these into functional specifications Support incidents per Business Service Level Agreement (SLA). Resolve escalated multi-discipline technical application and infrastructure incidents end to end per business SLA. Cooperate with support and project management teams on technical feasibility and considerations, prepare detailed technical plans, evaluate test results and to ensure supportable solution is being deployed by the projects Hand-on experience on the technical and business aspects of configuration management, system security requirements, the operations and maintenance of systems being supported and proposed system recovery procedures. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and provide feedback on the delivered service from suppliers What you bring Bachelor’s in Technology or related degree with minimum 5 years experience in the industry Understand the SAFE ways of working and have experience to work in an agile way Have knowledge of scripting languages and automation Have knowledge how to run Infrastructure as a code (Terraform, Azure Power Platform) Knowledge of platforms like Azure, AWS or BTP Concepts of microservices and/or containers (Docker, Kubernetes) Conceptual understanding of networks (routers, firewalls, ip networks) Concepts of SDI integration with SCP and other source systems Concepts of CPI development & trouble shooting Fiori Configs for SAP BTP/SCP CF End-user Management in SAP BT Understand OSI model (application vs network) Understand API’s and managing API’s Experience with SAP Basis administration and database management Experience with remote product administration, maintenance, troubleshooting and Upgrades Security vulnerability notes & CVE notes – Assess impact, relevancy and plan and deploy remediation Strong problem analysis and troubleshooting skills Good time management skills, ability to multitask to manage conflicting requirements Able to communicate clearly in spoken and written English Ability to work with teams from different cultures and in different time zones in a global, virtual environment. Knowledge of SAP HANA administration, Cloud Integrations Experience in IT Service Management. Basis skills in HANA cloud DBA and/or HANA Performance tuning is a bonus. Experience working with information risk management controls and ITIL processes Expertise skills in Oracle DBA and/or ABAP Performance tuning is a bonus. What we offer You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself. Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together. Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead. Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices. Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise. Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself. Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working. Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world. Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents. Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply. Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams. Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes. We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here. title: Sr. Specialist - Data Analytics
location: Bangalore RMZ-ECO WORLD / SHELL CENTRE – CHENNAI
jobDescription:
What’s the role It is recognised that the size and complexity of Shell Trading & Supply (T&S) has increased substantially over the past few years and the expectations around risk management from a regulatory perspective have also shifted for Energy Trading. As a result, and also recognising the potential to unlock additional value from enhanced risk management of our trading activities, a strategic decision has been made to make a major investment over the next 3-4 years to strengthen the risk management capabilities of the organisation from a people, process, data and systems perspective in both the first and second lines of defence. Sr. Specialist
- Data Analytics team within Credit focuses on the delivery of regular and ad hoc credit risk reporting and portfolio analytics to the commercial teams, the risk management teams and various other stakeholders such as the TSLT, EC and the production of risk information which will flow into external financial reporting. This role relates to Trading & Supply (T&S). Primary stakeholders are commercial teams, credit risk managers located in T&S hubs of London, Houston, Rotterdam, Dubai and Singapore. The role is focused on providing support for credit reporting and analytics activities globally. What you will be doing Support the development and operations of global credit risk reporting activities within T&S, including working with IT and other organisations to resolve issues where they arise. Develop and conduct credit risk analytics on both a pre- and post-deal basis; including, but not limited to, Potential Future Exposure (PFE), portfolio analytics, expected credit loss (ECL), credit value adjustment (CVA), credit reserves and cost of credit analysis. Combine business understanding with logical data modelling and process design skills to integrate new T&S businesses and enhanced activities into global operations. Ensure reporting and analytical tools have clear and appropriate documentation and controls. Develop and enhance appropriate data visualisations to support the use of credit reporting and analytics – e.g. Spotfire, Power BI and/or other visualisation tools. Understand the key ETRMs of T&S, with in-depth knowledge of how systems in their region interact with Risk systems and tools. title: Data Science Engagement Lead
jobDescription:
What’s the role The Commercial Data Science (CDS) team is a community of experts partnering with Shell’s business stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions through deep process understanding and technical excellence. As a Data Science Engagement Lead within the Digital Process Twin (DPT) portfolio, you will lead data scientists and collaborate with cross-functional business teams to identify transformation opportunities using process-centric data and guide the application of process mining, optimization, and AI/ML techniques to improve operational performance. Your work will drive measurable business outcomes by enhancing visibility, agility, and efficiency across Shell’s business operations. The DPT Centre of Excellence (Co E) aims to “Empower Process Transformation through Digital Process Twins” by applying advanced process mining and analytics capabilities. Shell is recognized as an industry leader in process mining, pioneering innovative analytical approaches and advancing the process twin concept. The Co E actively engages with academic partners, industry forums, and technology vendors to drive research, innovation, and thought leadership. If you are passionate about applying data science to process event data to drive organizational process transformation—and value collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning—we invite you to join us as a Data Science Engagement Lead. What you’ll be doing Lead process-mining consulting engagements, translating business challenges into analytical problem statements and actionable insights that drive measurable digital process transformation. Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to uncover inefficiencies, define transformation opportunities, and generate process-analytics use cases aligned with the Integrated Process Plan (IPP). Oversee the design and development of process data models, collaborating with process and data architects to ensure clean, integrated, and analysis-ready event data from enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, Service Now). Facilitate process discovery and value workshops, translating analytical findings into tangible business outcomes through clear, evidence-based, and persuasive data storytelling. Guide the delivery of analytical and AI/ML solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, technical excellence, and measurable value realization (e.g., process cycle-time reduction or cost-efficiency improvement). Champion change and capability adoption, organizing enablement sessions, roadshows, and awareness programs to promote process-mining and analytics capabilities across business Region / functions. Support collaboration with academic and technology partners to explore new analytical methods and contribute insights to product enhancement discussions that inform Shell’s Digital Process Twin (DPT) evolution. Mentor and coach data scientists, developing consulting, technical, and storytelling capabilities within the DPT community. Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to provide input on potential future use cases in process analytics, optimization, and AI. What you bring 10–12 years of total experience, including 6+ years in analytics consulting, of which 3+ years in process-mining consulting or process-analytics leadership within global organizations or leading consulting firms. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Technical Finance, or a related quantitative field. Combines deep analytical expertise with consulting leadership, leveraging prior hands-on experience in analytical solution development and data-driven problem solving to deliver measurable business outcomes. Process-Mining Technical Expertise: Strong command of process-mining concepts, algorithms, and tools (e.g., Celonis EMS, SAP Signavio, PM4Py), with proven ability to extract, model, and interpret event-log data to uncover inefficiencies, monitor compliance, and optimize end-to-end processes. Led the development and delivery of AI/ML use cases using process-centric data, integrating predictive and prescriptive models with process-mining insights to drive data-informed decisions and measurable process transformation. Designed and implemented process data models and event-data integration frameworks, collaborating with process architects, data engineers, and IT teams to ensure analysis-ready, high-quality datasets across enterprise systems. Delivered process-analytics and AI-driven consulting engagements across business domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain—identifying bottlenecks, quantifying value opportunities, and achieving measurable performance improvements. Champions disciplined and responsible data-science delivery, applying Agile practices, MLOps/Dev Ops workflows (e.g., Git Hub, CI/CD), and Responsible AI (XAI) principles to ensure transparency, scalability, and measurable business outcomes across global teams. Demonstrated strength in analytical storytelling, distilling complex analytical findings into persuasive narratives and visual insights that drive executive alignment and decision-making. Experience in leading and active engagement in professional communities, industry forums, and technology meetups to foster collaboration, share insights, and drive innovation in analytical methods and digital transformation initiatives. Proven expertise in applying process mining, optimization, machine learning, or AI techniques to process centric data for measurable business outcomes. Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and process data modeling, with experience transforming data from enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, HANA, or Service Now. Deep understanding of process data structures (case IDs, activities, timestamps, attributes) and the ability to build scalable analytics pipelines. Structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving approach with the ability to interpret and communicate analytical results clearly to diverse audiences. Ability to guide cross-functional teams, ensuring analytical solutions align with business strategies and deliver measurable value. Experience with cloud-based analytics environments and process-analytics platforms (e.g., Celonis EMS, SAP Signavio, Microsoft Process Mining) and familiarity with major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Understanding of end-to-end business-process lifecycles and value-chain optimization. Knowledge of process simulation, optimization, or Operations Research (OR) techniques for process improvement and decision support. Strong data storytelling and visualization skills, translating complex analytics into actionable business insights. Continuous-learning mindset, staying current with advances in process mining, AI/ML, and digital-twin technologies. Experience with complementary or open-source process-mining tools (e.g.,PM4PY, Pro M). Research and innovation orientation, contributing to proofs-of-concept or publications with academic and vendor partners. description: What’s the role The Commercial Data Science (CDS) team is a community of experts partnering with Shell’s business stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions through deep process understanding and technical excellence. As a Data Science Engagement Lead within the Digital Process Twin (DPT) portfolio, you will lead data scientists and collaborate with cross-functional business teams to identify transformation opportunities using process-centric data and guide the application of process mining, optimization, and AI/ML techniques to improve operational performance. Your work will drive measurable business outcomes by enhancing visibility, agility, and efficiency across Shell’s business operations. The DPT Centre of Excellence (CoE) aims to “Empower Process Transformation through Digital Process Twins” by applying advanced process mining and analytics capabilities. Shell is recognized as an industry leader in process mining, pioneering innovative analytical approaches and advancing the process twin concept. What you’ll be doing Lead process-mining consulting engagements, translating business challenges into analytical problem statements and actionable insights that drive measurable digital process transformation. Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to uncover inefficiencies, define transformation opportunities, and generate process-analytics use cases aligned with the Integrated Process Plan (IPP). Oversee the design and development of process data models, collaborating with process and data architects to ensure clean, integrated, and analysis-ready event data from enterprise systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow). Facilitate process discovery and value workshops, translating analytical findings into tangible business outcomes through clear, evidence-based, and persuasive data storytelling. Guide the delivery of analytical and AI/ML solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, technical excellence, and measurable value realization (e.g., process cycle-time reduction or cost-efficiency improvement). Champion change and capability adoption, organizing enablement sessions, roadshows, and awareness programs to promote process-mining and analytics capabilities across business Region / functions. Support collaboration with academic and technology partners to explore new analytical methods and contribute insights to product enhancement discussions that inform Shell’s Digital Process Twin (DPT) evolution. Mentor and coach data scientists, developing consulting, technical, and storytelling capabilities within the DPT community. Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to provide input on potential future use cases in process analytics, optimization, and AI. What you bring 10–12 years of total experience, including 6+ years in analytics consulting, of which 3+ years in process-mining consulting or process-analytics leadership within global organizations or leading consulting firms. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, Technical Finance, or a related quantitative field. Combines deep analytical expertise with consulting leadership, leveraging prior hands-on experience in analytical solution development and data-driven problem solving to deliver measurable business outcomes. Led the development and delivery of AI/ML use cases using process-centric data, integrating predictive and prescriptive models with process-mining insights to drive data-informed decisions and measurable process transformation. Designed and implemented process data models and event-data integration frameworks, collaborating with process architects, data engineers, and IT teams to ensure analysis-ready, high-quality datasets across enterprise systems. Delivered process-analytics and AI-driven consulting engagements across business domains such as Finance, Sales, Procurement, and Supply Chain—identifying bottlenecks, quantifying value opportunities, and achieving measurable performance improvements. Champions disciplined and responsible data-science delivery, applying Agile practices, MLOps/DevOps workflows (e.g., GitHub, CI/CD), and Responsible AI (XAI) principles to ensure transparency, scalability, and measurable business outcomes across global teams. Demonstrated strength in analytical storytelling, distilling complex analytical findings into persuasive narratives and visual insights that drive executive alignment and decision-making. Experience in leading and active engagement in professional communities, industry forums, and technology meetups to foster collaboration, share insights, and drive innovation in analytical methods and digital transformation initiatives. Proven expertise in applying process mining, optimization, machine learning, or AI techniques to process centric data for measurable business outcomes. Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and process data modeling, with experience transforming data from enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, HANA, or ServiceNow. Deep understanding of process data structures (case IDs, activities, timestamps, attributes) and the ability to build scalable analytics pipelines. Structured, hypothesis-driven problem-solving approach with the ability to interpret and communicate analytical results clearly to diverse audiences. Ability to guide cross-functional teams, ensuring analytical solutions align with business strategies and deliver measurable value. Experience with cloud-based analytics environments and process-analytics platforms (e.g., Celonis EMS, SAP Signavio, Microsoft Process Mining) and familiarity with major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Understanding of end-to-end business-process lifecycles and value-chain optimization. Knowledge of process simulation, optimization, or Operations Research (OR) techniques for process improvement and decision support. Strong data storytelling and visualization skills, translating complex analytics into actionable business insights. Continuous-learning mindset, staying current with advances in process mining, AI/ML, and digital-twin technologies.
